creator: Alexander Terp
description: Sighting 2026-11-11 (minor): the maker posted a helper a closing message that asked for no reply. The helper read it and went idle, and @muster told the maker it 'went idle without posting to you since it went to work 90s ago'. A second identical notice followed about a minute later ('23s ago') with no new post from the maker in between. The first is arguably right by the rule but noise for a message that wanted no answer; the second has no visible cause.
title: A helper told 'nothing further' earns its maker two idle-without-posting notices
